notes.title: Progress
notes.notes: [p]Once WTC : Love's Labour's Lost has been fully release, attention can now be fully put on this episode, at last.  Progress has been made with adding CG's, but there is a bit more story to be added, and then proof read and so on.[/p]

notes.title: CG News
notes.notes: At long last, CG work has started on this episode.  Character graphics are still ongoing and the final story may have changes, but it's getting towards a release!

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Currently the story is being updated to accommodate various surprises.

I'm hoping to start CG creation around July/August 2024 with hopefully a release either at the end of 2024 or very early 2025.

Hopefully, it'll be worth the (long) wait

notes.title: Story update
notes.notes:
Recently added a small addition to the story.  I hope to get the CGs started soon after Love's Labour's Lost has been released (and maybe some of Relentless ones have been updated), so sometime after July 2024.  

I am really hoping for release at the end of 2024 or early 2025

notes.title: Progress
notes.notes:
Progress is coming along well.  There is about 18 standard backgrounds left to do, and about the same number of characters.  

With any luck I'll be able to finish the backgrounds in Q4 2022, with the aim of starting the CGs in early 2023.

notes.title: Test Play will end on Monday 30th November
notes.notes: The Test Play for WTC 2/3 will end on Monday 30th.  Depending on how things go, it may be back later next year.
